title: Projectile Motion
description: Simulates projectile motion with vector decomposition. A red dot launches with initial velocity vx = 4.0, vy = 6.0 under gravity = −9.8 m/s². The dot's position is updated via a ValueTracker, with a yellow TracedPath showing the trajectory. Blue and green arrows represent the horizontal (vx) and vertical (vy) velocity components in real time. The animation runs for the full time of flight.
key_objects: Arrow vy (green, vertical velocity, shrinks with time)
what_to_modify: Change vx, vy, or gravity to alter the trajectory. Add air resistance, show the max height or range as labels, change projectile color, add a ground line, or display a velocity magnitude indicator.
